name: UF-VGA-ISO-DUNGEON-CHUNK
note: The same dungeon room in 256-color VGA: juggernautXL checkpoint, dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu + karras (see ⚙ Advanced). Seed locked, 5 per render. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/VGA-ISO-DUNGEON-CHUNK.  (sample: seed 675632800)

form.subject: ((isometric:2.0)) view of a small ((stone)) dungeon room with a treasure chest, torches and a wooden door, ((perfect lines)) and ((pixel perfect)) ((highly detailed:2.0))
form.negative: 3d render, realistic, photograph, blurry, smooth gradient, antialiased, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, signature, ((vegetation:1.7)), ((character:1.5))

sample_command: pixelmon '((isometric:2.0)) view of a small ((stone)) dungeon room with a treasure chest, torches and a wooden door, ((perfect lines)) and ((pixel perfect)) ((highly detailed:2.0))' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 0.7 --negative '3d render, realistic, photograph, blurry, smooth gradient, antialiased, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, signature, ((vegetation:1.7)), ((character:1.5))' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette VGA --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --no-sprite-suffix --pixel-size 1x1 --cfg 7 --sampler dpmpp_2m_sde_gpu --scheduler karras --base juggernautXL_v9.safetensors --smooth mode --filter nearest --seed 675632800
